Subject: mCap: security discovery & evidence requests

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of pain/goals you shared:
- Need predictable retention and exportability for audit logs (7+ years for some entities).
- SOC 2 Type 2 evidence and a formal DPA are gating items for legal/procurement.
- Expecting a vendor pen test report (or recent third-party test) for mid-tier processing workloads.
- Want options for customer-controlled KMS and regionally isolated logs for EU customers.

What we can provide (short list):
- SOC 2 summary and scope (attached): high-level controls and last Type 2 date. [Attachment: SOC2_summary_2026.pdf]
- Sample audit-log export (CSV) and retention policy options (we support configurable retention + long-term archival).
- DPA draft we typically share (we’ll route through legal if you want edits).
- Notes on pen test cadence: we can share redacted executive summary or coordinate a secure review with your security team.

Requested next steps (proposed timeline):
1) You to send vendor questionnaire or a prioritized list of evidence items by Friday 7/2 (you mentioned a template).
2) We provide SOC2 summary + audit-log sample + DPA draft by EOD Monday 7/5.
3) Technical deep dive (30–45m) with your security/infra team the week of 7/12 — propose Tues/Wed mornings PT.

If that aligns, I’ll upload the materials to the shared Drive link below and mark action items in the HubSpot deal.

Best,
Ben

Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0102

Thanks for the clear summary. That matches our understanding. I’m attaching our standard vendor security questionnaire (we try to get a first pass back to procurement in 5 business days). Can you confirm the following as part of your deliverables?

- Completed vendor questionnaire (spreadsheet)
- SOC 2: full control matrix or at least an auditor attestation + scope
- DPA: initial draft for our legal to review
- Audit log sample filtered to show: user actions, admin events, and data access events

Questions from Tom (cc’d):
- Can audit logs be exported programmatically to our S3 bucket?
- What retention tiers are configurable versus fixed by vendor?

We’re also going to bring our infra/security lead into the deep dive — I’ll confirm availability and send calendar invites for the week of 7/12.

Ben — thanks for the ping. Quick notes and ETA: 

1) SOC2 control matrix / scope: I’ll pull the matrix (redacted) and upload by EOD Monday 7/5. We’ll include the auditor letter and attestations where possible.
2) Pen test executive summary: we have a 2026 third-party pen test exec summary I can redact and share by 7/5 as well.
3) Audit log sample + S3 export: Monica, please produce a CSV with anonymized user IDs and three event types (user_action, admin_change, data_access). Include a short README on how to programmatically pull exports into S3 (we support signed transfers and an S3 sink connector).
4) Retention: configurable tiers — 30 days (hot), 1 year (warm), archive (configurable to 7+ years via cold storage export). Will document limits and costs in the README.

I’ll add notes in the Drive folder (https://drive.redwood.com/shared/mcap-security-pack) and ping Ben when materials are uploaded.
